Name: Item Bags for Lumisteria Serene Meadows
Author: MsHakunaMatata
Description:
This Item Bags add-on is here for all your organizing needs!

With Lumisteria's permission, I have created 3 custom item bags for her Serene Meadow mod.
You'll be able to manage your inventory easily, and keep crops, seeds and food organized, including bag names and descriptions that try to reflect the mod's spirit. 


[b][size=3]How do I obtain the Item Bags? [/size]
Requirements
[/b]You need to install:[list]
[*]Item Bags (and all its dependencies)
[*]Lumisteria Serene Meadow (and all its dependencies)
[/list][size=2][i]This is not a mod in itself but a pack to use with item bags, it will not spawn the bags if you don't install both of these.[/i][/size]

[b]Installation[/b]
Just drag and drop the contents in the same folder where you've installed Item Bags and the bags will be saved in the corresponding folder.

[b]Buying the Bags[/b]
[list]
[*]Crops and Seeds are available at Pierre's Shop
[*]Food is available at Gus' Saloon
[/list]

[b]Other plans[/b]
More add-ons will be on the way, always trying to bring some of the mod's own vibes to the bags. 
If you'd like to see some specific mods get their own add-ons, you can leave a post for me to consider.

[b]Thanks[/b]
Uhm, first of course, to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1946434]SlayerDharok[/url], whose mod has been so useful for us players with a lot of crops, artisan goods and items.
Now, a big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url], for a wonderful mod and the permission to create this. There are never enough flowers in the valley!
And to the rest of you guys, who've always encouraged my attempts at my very humble modding.
